title: 1weiho/open-slide
claim: 1weiho/open-slide — A slide framework built for agents.
why_good: Agents got good at writing decks and had nowhere to render them — PowerPoint XML is hostile to generate and hand-rolled HTML slides break on scaling. 6k stars for plumbing rather than an end-user app says builders want a slide target they can emit into.
value: The framework is the wedge, not the product. Money sits a layer up: hosted rendering, brand and template locking for teams, share links with view analytics, and PPTX/PDF export as a paid API for the many agent products that need 'export to deck' and will not build it. Gamma has already shown a deck tool can carry subscription pricing.
risk: Closer to a feature than a company. Gamma, Canva and Microsoft are all adding agent-authored decks, and whoever owns the assistant can ship a native slide target that makes the framework redundant. MIT plumbing is easy to absorb, and the durable asset — the hosted layer — does not exist yet.
does: A React slide framework aimed at coding agents: describe a deck in natural language, the agent emits components, and open-slide handles canvas, scaling, layout and export.
edge: Agents got good at writing decks and had nowhere to render them — PowerPoint XML is hostile to generate and hand-rolled HTML slides break on scaling. 6k stars for plumbing rather than an end-user app says builders want a slide target they can emit into.
why_use: Gives an agent a deck format it can actually write, with the layout and scaling problems already solved.
hook: Transform agent-generated content into stunning presentations with open-slide.

zh.claim: 将代理生成的内容转化为令人惊叹的演示文稿，使用 open-slide。
zh.hook: 使用 open-slide，将代理生成的内容转化为令人惊叹的演示文稿。
zh.does: 面向编码 Agent 的 React 幻灯片框架：用自然语言描述一份 deck，Agent 生成组件，open-slide 负责画布、缩放、排版和导出。
zh.edge: Agent 已经会写 deck，却没有地方渲染——PowerPoint XML 极难生成，手写 HTML 幻灯片一缩放就崩。6k star 给的是底层管道而不是终端产品，说明开发者要的是一个可以直接输出到的幻灯片目标格式。
zh.why_use: 给 Agent 一种它真能写出来的幻灯片格式，排版和缩放问题已经替你解决。
zh.value: 框架是切入点，不是产品。钱在上一层：托管渲染、团队品牌与模板锁定、带浏览分析的分享链接，以及把 PPTX/PDF 导出做成付费 API——很多 Agent 产品都需要“导出成 deck”，但都不会自己做。Gamma 已经证明幻灯片工具撑得起订阅定价。
zh.risk: 它更像一个功能而不是一家公司。Gamma、Canva、微软都在加 Agent 生成 deck 的能力，而掌握助手入口的一方随时可以内置幻灯片输出，让框架变得多余。MIT 协议的管道层很容易被吸收，真正有护城河的托管层目前还不存在。
zh.why_good: Agent 已经会写 deck，却没有地方渲染——PowerPoint XML 极难生成，手写 HTML 幻灯片一缩放就崩。6k star 给的是底层管道而不是终端产品，说明开发者要的是一个可以直接输出到的幻灯片目标格式。

pick_reason: The project addresses a specific need for coding agents to create slide decks, but its market potential may be limited.
